title: Big Pink 2 Bedroom Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Located near the fitness center, pools and tennis courts, This 3 bedroom lockoff in the Big Pink cottage is also just a short walk to Ruskin Place, Central Square and the beautiful Seaside beach.
description_expanded: Description142 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 2 FULLSPrime Seaside LocationBig Pink 2 is a classic Seaside two-bedroom cottage located just steps from Seaside Avenue and Ruskin Park, with the beach only a short walk away. This central location places guests within easy walking distance of the shoreline, Seaside town center, shopping, dining, and community events—making it an ideal home base for experiencing all that Seaside has to offer.Arrival & Wrap-Around Front PorchThe home features a long private driveway with parking for two vehicles, a valuable amenity in Seaside. Upon arrival, guests are welcomed by a large wrap-around open-air porch with bench seating and a porch swing. This inviting space is perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or relaxing in the evening breeze.Main Living Areas & KitchenInside, the first floor opens to a bright and comfortable living room furnished with dual sofas and two club chairs, offering ample seating for gathering after beach days. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six to eight guests and flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen.The kitchen is bright and white, featuring breakfast bar seating for six, a large farmhouse sink, and generous counter space for preparing meals. A half bath is conveniently located off the main living areas for guest use.Screened Rear Porch & Outdoor SpaceAt the rear of the home, the screened-in porch serves as a favorite gathering spot. This space is furnished with cheerful outdoor seating, including a gliding swing, rockers for four, and a bistro table. The porch overlooks a lush, private yard, creating a peaceful retreat. A gas grill is located just off the rear porch, perfect for outdoor cooking after a day at the beach.Second Floor Bedrooms & LaundryThe primary king bedroom is located on the second floor and features a mounted flat-screen TV and an updated private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.The second bedroom, also on the second floor, includes two full beds, making it well suited for children or additional guests. A full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located in a second-floor laundry closet.Note: Guests may choose to have access to a first-floor queen bedroom in place of the second-floor king bedroom if they prefer sleeping accommodations on separate floors.Third Floor Tower RoomThe third floor features a glass-enclosed tower room with treetop and town views. This unique space includes wrap-around bench seating and a TV, making it an ideal hangout for kids, teens, or a quiet retreat away from the main living areas.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURESLocated on the east side of Seaside and Seaside Private Residential Beach Access at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside is the largest private residential beach on 30AJust steps to Seaside Ave & Ruskin ParkPrivate Driveway w/parking for twoLarge wrap-around front porch w/swingOutside showerWasher & DryerPeacock Alley Linens - Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedNo pets allowed
